contentHtml:
The purpose of this workshop is to learn econometrics and machine learning and apply it to real-world problems. Topics will prioritize the interests of participants and aim to cover a wide range of topics. Students interested in learning and applying the latest methods are welcome.

(Accepting Double Degree)
